spans.s: वि—सेचक mfn. = विगतः सेचको यस्मात्, Pat.
(once in Pañcat. n.; ifc. f(आ). ) distinction, difference between (two gen., two loc., or gen. and instr.), GṛŚrS.; MBh. &c.
characteristic difference, peculiar mark, special property, speciality, peculiarity, Mn.; MBh. &c.

a kind, species, individual (e.g. वृक्ष-व्˚, a species of tree, in comp. often also = special, peculiar, particular, different, e.g. छन्दो-व्˚, ‘a particular metre’, विशेष-मण्डन, ‘a peculiar ornament’; अर्घ-विशेषाः, ‘different prices’), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
(pl.) various objects, Megh.
distinction, peculiar merit, excellence, superiority (in comp. often = excellent, superior, choice, distinguished, e.g. आकृति-व्˚, ‘an excellent form’ ; cf. विशेष-प्रतिपत्ति), Mn.; MBh. &c.
(in gram.) a word which defines or limits the meaning of another word (cf. वि-शेषक and वि-शेषण)

(in phil.) particularity, individuality, essential difference or individual essence (with the Vaiśeṣikas the 5th category or Padārtha, belonging to the 9 eternal substances or Dravyas, viz. soul, time, place, ether, and the 5 atoms of earth, water, light, air, and mind, which are said to be so essentially different that one can never be the other),
IW. 66
(in medicine) a favourable turn or crisis of a sickness, Suśr.
(in rhet.) statement of difference or distinction, individualization, variation, Kuval. (cf. विशेषोक्ति)
a sectarian mark, any mark on the forehead (= तिलक), L.
(in geom.) the hypotenuse, Śulbas.
N. of the primary elements or Mahā-bhūtas (q.v.), MaitrUp.
the earth as an element, BhP.
the mundane egg, ib.
= विराज्, ib.
mf(आ)n. extraordinary, abundant, Ragh. ii, 14 (B. विशेषात् for विशेषा)
&c. See p. 990, col. 2.
or ibc. (exceedingly, especially, particularly, even more, Mn.; MBh. &c.; येन येन विशेषेण, in any way whatever, MBh.)
(exceedingly, especially, particularly, even more, Mn.; MBh. &c.; आत् ifc., by reason or in consequence of VarBṛS.)
वि-शेष—करण n. making better, improvement, Mālav.
वि-शेष—कृत् mfn. making a distinction, distinguishing, RPrāt.
वि-शेष—गर्हणीय mfn. especially reprehensible, even more blamable, Kuval.
वि-शेष—गुण m. a special or distinct quality, Nīlak.
(in phil.) a substance of a distinct kind (as soul, time, space, ether, and the five atoms enumerated above), W.
वि-शेष—ज्ञ mfn. knowing distinctions, judicious, Kāv.; Kathās.
(ifc.) knowing various kinds of R.
वि-शेष—ज्ञान-वादार्थ m. N. of wk.
वि-शेष—तस् ind. according to the difference of, in proportion to (comp.), Mn. xi, 2
especially, particularly, above all, Mn.; MBh. &c.
individually, singly, Vedāntas.
वि-शेष—त्व n. distinction, notion of the particular, L.
वि-शेष—दृश्य mfn. of splendid aspect or appearance, Ragh.
वि-शेष—धर्म m. a peculiar or different duty, W.
a special law, MW.
वि-शेष—नियम m. a partic. observance, MBh.
वि-शेष—निरुक्ति f. (ibc.) ‘explanation of differences’
N. of wk.
वि-शेष—निरुक्ति-क्रोड m. N. of wk.
वि-शेष—निरुक्ति-टीका f. N. of wk.
वि-शेष—निरुक्ति-प्रकाश m. N. of wk.
वि-शेष—निरुक्˚त्य्-आलोक m. N. of wk.
वि-शेष—पतनीय n. a partic. crime or sin, Yājñ. iii, 298
वि-शेष—पदार्थ m. (in Nyāya) the category of particularity (cf. above under विशेष)
वि-शेष—प्रतिपत्ति f. a special mark of honour or respect, Ragh.
वि-शेष—प्रतिषेध m. a special exception, MW.
वि-शेष—प्रमाण n. sp˚ authority, ib.
वि-शेष—भाग m. a partic. part of an elephant's forefoot, L.
वि-शेष—भावना f. reflecting on or perceiving difference, W.
(in arithm.) a partic. operation in extracting roots, composition by the difference of the products, ib.
वि-शेष—भूत-परिशिष्ट n. N. of wk.
वि-शेष—मण्डन n. a peculiar ornament, Śak.
वि-शेष—मति m. N. of a Bodhisattva and of another man, Buddh.
वि-शेष—मित्र m. N. of a man, Buddh.
वि-शेष—रमणीय mfn. especially delightful, particularly pleasant, Vikr.
वि-शेष—लक्षण n. any specific or characteristic mark or sign, W.
वि-शेष—लक्ष˚णा-टीका f. N. of wk.
वि-शेष—लिङ्ग n. a partic. mark, specific property, attribute of a subordinate class, Kap.
वि-शेष—वचन n. ‘distinguishing or defining word’, an adjective, apposition, Pāṇ. viii, 1, 74
a special text, special rule or precept, W.
वि-शेष—वत् mfn. pursuing something particular, MBh. ii, 849
possessed of some distinguishing property or specific quality, BhP.
excellent, superior, better than (abl.), MBh.; Hariv.
making a difference (see अ-व्˚)
वि-शेष—वाद m. the above doctrine of the Vaiśeṣikas
वि-शेष—वाद-टीका f. N. of wk.
वि-शेष—वादिन् m. an adherent of that doctrine, Sāṃkhyak., Sch.
वि-शेष—विक्रम-रुचि mfn. taking delight in splendid heroism, Bhartṛ.
वि-शेष—विद् mfn. = ज्ञ, MBh.
वि-शेष—विद्वस् m. ‘eminently learned’, a sage, philosopher, W.
वि-शेष—विधि m. a special rule or observance, W.
वि-शेष—व्याप्ति f. (in logic) a form of Vyāpti or pervasion, L.
N. of wk. (also -रहस्य n.)
वि-शेष—व्याप्ति—रहस्य n. N. of wk.
वि-शेष—शार्ङ्गधर m. N. of wk.
वि-शेष—शालिन् mfn. possessing peculiar merit or excellence, Kir.
वि-शेष—शास्त्र n. (in gram.) a special rule (= अपवाद), MW.
वि-शेष—स्थ mfn. being (found only) in excellent persons or things, Kāvyād. ii, 170
वि-शे˚षातिदेश m. a sp˚ supplementary rule, ib.
वि-शे˚षामृत n. N. of wk.
वि-शे˚षार्थ m. the sense or essence of distinction, difference (अम् ind. for the sake of d˚, MW.)
वि-शे˚षार्थम् ind., for the sake of d˚, MW.
वि-शे˚षार्थ-प्रकाशिका f. N. of wk.
वि-शे˚षार्थ-बोधिका f. N. of wk.
वि-शे˚षार्थिन् mfn. seeking for excellence or distinction, MBh.
particular in searching for anything, MW.
वि-शे˚षार्थि-ता f. the searching for something better, Pañcat.
वि-शे˚षावस्यक-निर्युक्ति f. N. of wk.

वि-शे˚षोक्ति f. ‘mention of difference’, N. of a figure of speech (in which the excellence of a thing is implied by comparing it to some highly prized object, yet mentioning the difference, e.g. द्यूतंनाम पुरुषस्यासिंहासनं राज्यम्, ‘truly gambling is a man's throneless kingdom’, Mṛcch. ii, 6/7), Vām. iv, 3, 23 (cf. Kāvyād. ii, 323 &c.)
enumeration of merits, panegyric, W.
वि-शे˚षोच्छ्वसित n. the peculiar breath or life (cherished object), a peculiar treasure (applied to an object especially dear), MW.
वि-शे˚षोद्देश m. (in Nyāya) a partic. kind of enunciation, ib.
= वि-शेष, distinction, difference, Bhāṣāp.
distinguishing, qualifying, specifying, L.
n. a mark on the forehead (made with sandal &c.), R.; Mālav.; Kathās. (cf. पत्त्रव्˚)
an attribute, predicate, W.
a partic. figure of speech (in which the difference of two objects otherwise said to be similar is dwelt upon; cf. विशेषोक्ति), Kuval.
N. of a scholar, Buddh.
of a country, Nalac.
a series of three stanzas forming one grammatical sentence
(cf. युग्म and कलापक), Śatr.
a kind of metre, Col.
वि-शेषक—च्छेद्य n. N. of one of the 64 Kalās (prob. the art of painting sectarian marks on the forehead), Cat.
distinguishing, discriminative, specifying, qualifying, L.
distinctive (as a property), W.
the act of distinguishing &c., distinction, discrimination, particularization, BhP.; Sarvad.; Sāh.
a distinguishing mark or attribute, MBh.
(in gram.) ‘differencer’, a word which particularizes or defines (another word which is called वि-शेष्य, q.v.), attribute, adjective, adverb, apposition, predicate, Pāṇ.; Tarkas.; Sāh. &c.
a species, kind, MBh. vii, 1124
surpassing, excelling, ib. i, 73
(in rhet.) = विशेषोक्ति, Sāh.
वि-शेषण—खण्डन n. N. of wk.
वि-शेषण—ज्ञान-वादार्थ m. N. of wk.
वि-शेषण—ता f. the state of a distinguisher or of distinguishing, Bhāṣāp.
individuality, MW. (-सम्बन्ध m. the relation of predicate to subject, ib.)
वि-शेषण—ता—सम्बन्ध m., the relation of predicate to subject, ib.
वि-शेषण—त्रय-वैयर्थ्य n. N. of wk.
वि-शेषण—त्व n. = -ता, MW.
adjectival nature, Sāy.
वि-शेषण—द्वय-वैयर्थ्य n. N. of wk.
वि-शेषण—पद n. a title of honour, Mudr.
वि-शेषण—मात्र-प्रयोग m. the use of an adjective for a substantive (e.g. सागराम्बरा, ‘the sea-girt’, for पृथिवी, ‘the earth’), Vām. v, 1, 10
वि-शेषण—विशेष्य-ता f. the relation of predicate and subject, Vedāntas.
वि-शेषण—विशेष्य-भाव m. the relation of predicate and subject, Vedāntas.
वि-शेषण—वत् mfn. endowed with discrimination, MW.
having a distinguishing attribute, ib.
वि-शेषण—वर्ग m. N. of a ch. of the Sabda-ratnāvalī lexicon.
वि-˚शेषणी-√ कृ P. -करोति, to predicate, Kusum.
वि-शेषण—शेषणीय mfn. to be distinguished or discriminated, W.
to be marked as different or distinct, ib.
to be particularized, MW.
distinguished, defined, characterized, Śaṃk.
preferred, Kām.
superior to, better than (abl.), MBh.
surpassed, exceeded, Hariv.; Mālav.
predicated, attributed, W.
वि-˚शेषिन् mfn. distinct, individual, BhP.
(ifc.) vying with, rivalling, Hariv.
to be (or being) distinguished or qualified or particularized (see comp.)
the word to be ‘differenced’ or distinguished (from another word which is called वि-शेषण, q.v.), a substantive, noun, the object or subject of a predicate, Pāṇ.; Tarkas.; Vedāntas.
वि-शेष्य—ता f. the being defined or qualified, substantival nature, Kusum. (-वाद m. N. of wk.)
वि-शेष्य—ता—वाद m. N. of wk.
वि-शेष्य—त्व n. = -ता f., KātyŚr., Sch.
वि-˚शेष्यक (ifc.) = ˚शेष्य, Bhāṣāp.
